scenario: Conversation between two friends, one of whom has recently found out that the other friend has been involved with their long-term partner
learner_goal: Confess to your friend that you have been involved with their long-term partner (<extra_info>Extra information: you have been involved with your friend's partner knowingly and want to come clean.</extra_info>)
partner_goal: Maintain the friendship without causing a huge argument (<extra_info>Extra information: you don't want to lose a good friend over this.</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: William, I need to tell you something difficult: I have been involved with your long-term partner, and I knew they were with you. I am so sorry — I should have told you sooner. I want to be honest now and will accept whatever you decide; I can answer any questions.

transcript.speaker: William Brown
transcript.content: Mia… thanks for telling me. I’m shocked and really hurt — I won’t pretend otherwise — but I appreciate your honesty. I need to know a couple of things when you can: when did this happen and is it still going on? I don’t want to blow up or lose you over this if it can be avoided, but I also need some time to process before we talk through everything. Please don’t contact my partner or share this with anyone else right now. Can we pause for a day or two and then meet in person to talk properly?

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: William, I’m so sorry. It started about six months ago and ended a few weeks ago — it’s not still happening. I won’t contact your partner or tell anyone; take the time you need and let me know when you’re ready to meet in person.

transcript.speaker: William Brown
transcript.content: Thanks, Mia. I appreciate you telling me and for agreeing not to contact my partner or anyone else right now. I’m really hurt and surprised, but I don’t want to make any snap decisions. I need a couple of days to process this alone — please don’t message me about it for 48 hours unless it’s urgent. I’ll reach out in two days to set a time to meet in person and talk properly. I value our friendship and want to handle this honestly and calmly when we speak.

scenario_title: Confession of infidelity between close friends with information asymmetry, high emotional stakes, and trust breach | skills from the confessor managing admission of betrayal to preserve trust and limit fallout
